translations.text: Du und der Computer, je fünf Kugeln: Weiß für dich, Rot für den Computer. Versenke alle fünf deiner Kugeln im Loch am anderen Ende ihres Startplatzes, bevor der Computer es schafft.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: Tu e il computer, cinque bilie a testa: bianche per te, rosse per il computer. Imbuca tutte e cinque le tue nella buca all'estremità opposta a dove sono partite, prima del computer.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: Tu e o computador, cinco bolas cada um: brancas para ti, vermelhas para o computador. Mete as tuas cinco no buraco do lado oposto ao de onde partiram, antes do computador.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: Você e o computador, cinco bolas cada um: brancas para você, vermelhas para o computador. Encaçape suas cinco no buraco do lado oposto ao de onde saíram, antes do computador.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: あなたとコンピューターで、各自5個の球を使う。あなたは白、コンピューターは赤。スタート位置と反対側の穴に、コンピューターより先に自分の5個を全部沈めよう。

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: 당신과 컴퓨터가 각자 공 5개로 해. 당신은 흰 공, 컴퓨터는 빨간 공. 컴퓨터보다 먼저, 출발한 곳 반대편 구멍에 내 공 5개를 모두 넣어.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: 你和电脑，每方五个球：你用白球，电脑用红球。抢在电脑之前，把自己的五个球全部打进起点另一端的洞里。

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: Ты и компьютер, по пять шаров: белые у тебя, красные у компьютера. Загони все свои пять в лузу на дальнем от старта конце раньше компьютера.

translations.key: You and the computer, five balls each: white for you, red for the computer. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the computer does.
translations.text: أنت والكمبيوتر، لكل منكما خمس كرات: البيضاء لك والحمراء للكمبيوتر. أدخل كراتك الخمس كلها في الحفرة في الطرف المقابل لمكان بدايتها، قبل الكمبيوتر.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Tú y el ordenador: tú juegas con la blanca y el ordenador con la amarilla. La bola roja y los cinco bolos del centro son de los dos.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Toi et l'ordinateur : tu joues la blanche, l'ordinateur la jaune. La bille rouge et les cinq quilles du centre sont communes.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Du und der Computer: Du spielst die Weiße, der Computer die Gelbe. Die rote Kugel und die fünf Kegel in der Mitte gehören beiden.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Tu e il computer: tu giochi la bianca, il computer la gialla. La bilia rossa e i cinque birilli al centro sono di entrambi.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Tu e o computador: tu jogas com a branca, o computador com a amarela. A bola vermelha e os cinco pinos do meio são partilhados.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Você e o computador: você joga com a branca, o computador com a amarela. A bola vermelha e os cinco pinos do meio são compartilhados.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: あなたとコンピューターで、あなたは白球、コンピューターは黄球を使います。赤球と中央の5本のピンは共通です。

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: 당신은 흰 공, 컴퓨터는 노란 공으로 칩니다. 빨간 공과 가운데 핀 5개는 함께 씁니다.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: 你和电脑：你用白球，电脑用黄球。红球和中间的五根木柱双方共用。

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Ты и компьютер: ты играешь белым, компьютер жёлтым. Красный шар и пять кеглей в центре общие.

translations.key: You and the computer: you play the white, the computer the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: أنت والكمبيوتر: أنت تلعب بالبيضاء والكمبيوتر بالصفراء. الكرة الحمراء والأوتاد الخمسة في الوسط مشتركة.
